[h1]What is truly going on here?[/h1]

The Jam Scrapz Collection was suppose to be a collection of our 'best' game jam submissions and repurpose them for commercial profit to make a living in this already declining US economy. Since we can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2097480?emclan=103582791472696535&emgid=3698063796882485697]no longer trust the company behind the "best engine on the planet"[/url], that obviously means JSC can no longer achieve the goal it solely existed for - honest profit and honest value, and it also means all motivation to complete the collection eventually waned. In addition to this, we have virtually no audience to develop or market this collection to (besides maybe a pocket few in single digits).

We learned from my mistake after wasting 5 years developing Qorena, a game that was also suppose to be commercial but due to misfortunate circumstances and a blunder on Steam during early access in 2020, the game was since doomed to a situation where making it free seemed to be the best course of action, so I did. Even then, We tried to be optimistic in hopes to turn the users who got the game free in early access into active player-traffic for the MP servers in the game. This ultimately proved futile. No matter what we did to improve the quality of the game, no one was playing; no one cared.

We do not want to make the same mistake with the Jam Scrapz Collection, so we decided to make concessions by cancelling the rest of the projects that were planned with this collection, including Episodes 2 and 3 of Gene-Soldier, to shorten development time. Better to just focus on the games already guaranteed for this collection than risk making anymore promises we couldn't keep.


Thank you to those who visited and tried the Jam Scrapz Collection at the 2023 Winter Steam Next Fest and those who stuck with us beyond that, up to this point.

If you like the games we make, you can check out [url=https://qore.world/]Qore World[/url]. This site is where most of our passion remains.

You can also check out the rest of our content on our [url=https://linktr.ee/NeotlEmpire]LinkTree[/url] if you prefer instead. We do more than develop video games.

notes.title: Quick Update for Interactive Hub
notes.content: Now that Jam Scrapz Collection is free, there is no point in bundling all games into the main build. Now only the files for Interactive Hub remains. If you want to play the other games, the DLCs are freely available now. Just download and install them and you're good to go!

notes.title: WE ARE DONE WITH EPIC GAMES: ALL Unreal Engine games will become FREE FOREVER.
notes.content:
We have made an important announcement regarding all of our products actively being sold on all digital storefronts. Any that use Unreal Engine it are extremely affected.

The COMPLETE article can be read [url=https://neotlempire.com/2023/05/31/we-are-done-with-epic-games/]here[/url].

For those of you who are too busy or too lazy to read a two-page long sermon on what is happening, here is the [b]TL:DR[/b] version:

We have decided to do what many developers may consider "the unthinkable", or even "the utterly insane". From this day forth, we will begin the process to [b]convert ALL of our projects using any of the Unreal Engines into NON-COMMERCIAL ones or switch engines.[/b]

[list]
[*] ALL games using UE currently on storefronts will become [b]FREE[/b].

[*] ALL games using UE we have currently in development that meets or exceeds 50% of progress will also be released for [b]FREE[/b].

[*] ALL games using UE we have currently in development that exceeds below 50% of progress will be [b]RESTARTED[/b] using a [b]DIFFERENT[/b] engine. Our engine of choice will depend on the project type, platforms, and the scope.

[*] ANY new games we have planned on lineup but not yet started will be using a [b]DIFFERENT[/b] engine.
[/list]

We are MOVING FAR AWAY from Unreal Engine and abandoning Epic Games. We are moving on to greener pastures.
